notes:
- Date Added in Landscape Mode Only: Shows when songs were added (dd.MM.yyyy) only in landscape mode and only on your own playlists, collaborative playlists you can edit, and Liked Songs
- No Placeholder 01.01.1970 Dates: Filters out Spotify Unix epoch placeholder dates (e.g. on Daily Mixes) and hides Date Added on algorithmic/external playlists
- Active account display and seamless track-end ad recovery (from 1.0.236)
